# Deploy to Databricks Apps

Generated by SAShiny 0.0.0 (CONTRACT.md 6.8.6). Replace every `<...>` placeholder.

The app runs Shiny for Python on the Databricks Apps runtime. The runtime cannot install Java, so it
reaches SAS Viya over HTTPS only. The workspace's serverless egress must allow these host:port
pairs, and `pypi.org` and `files.pythonhosted.org` for the app build:

- viya.example.com:443

The SAS profile is reachable only over a private network. Attach a network connectivity
configuration with a private endpoint rule for each host to the workspace first.

## 1. Store the SAS credentials

```sh
databricks secrets create-scope sas-prod
databricks secrets put-secret sas-prod sas-user
databricks secrets put-secret sas-prod sas-password
```

The CLI prompts for each value; never pass a value on the command line.

## 2. Create the app

```sh
databricks apps create --json @databricks/app.json
```

## 3. Upload and deploy

```sh
databricks sync bundle /Workspace/Users/<user>/sas-reports
databricks apps deploy sas-reports --source-code-path /Workspace/Users/<user>/sas-reports
```

## 4. Share the app

```sh
databricks apps update-permissions sas-reports --json '{"access_control_list": [{"group_name": "<group>", "permission_level": "CAN_USE"}]}'
```
